title: Task board
partial: More matching tasks may be available. Counts cover only the loaded tasks in this view.
navigationHelp: Scroll this board horizontally to reach every status. Use Tab to reach task and parent buttons, then Enter or Space to open them.
dragHelp: Drag to another status. For keyboard editing, use Change status.
dragOrderHelp: Drag between cards to change their order or status. For keyboard status editing, use Change status.
